decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a coherent multi-axis drop near index 465 with persistent offset, and (2) a late-stage inflection in all axes starting ~725, possibly indicating a reversal or new trend. Other segments show typical noise or smooth motion without ambiguous superposed changes.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample drop in all three axes (N, E, U) around index 465–468, followed by a sustained offset: N drops ~4 mm, E drops ~2 mm, U drops ~3 mm. The change is abrupt and coherent across axes; no clear return within the window, though minor fluctuations persist.

Linear trend reversal in U-axis from ~index 725 onward: U shifts from steady decline to upward slope over last 5 samples; N and E show concurrent small but coherent inflection—N flattens then rises slightly, E transitions from flat to gentle rise. Suggests possible onset of recovery or new motion regime; boundaries uncertain due to coarse sampling near end.
